prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one wide 2:1 interactive adventure game background, original pixel art bedroom for Poketurismo.
Primary request: a believable modest young adult car enthusiast's bedroom in provincial Northern Italy circa 2000–2002, as a 1990s management/point-and-click game's clickable room menu.
Style: strict low resolution pixel art drawn on a logical 768x384 pixel grid, crisp square pixels, flat clustered shading, limited warm palette, handcrafted 1990s PC game art, no photorealistic textures, smooth rendering, depth of field or modern 3D.
Composition: wide unbroken room viewed from its open fourth wall, slightly elevated frontal three-quarter perspective, FULL room floor and furniture visible, all six distinct interactive props clearly readable and unobscured, with gaps between them, not a collage. Room spans image from left to right, normal human furniture scale.
Layout for clickable props: LEFT zone has a tall wall mirror over a small dresser, a motor club membership card and plain wallet in front of the mirror. CENTER-LEFT wooden desk has a large beige CRT computer with blue Windows-era desktop, beige keyboard and tower underneath, worn desk chair tucked in. CENTER foreground of desk has a LARGE closed dark green photographic ring binder/album with a small car photo on its cover, completely separate from keyboard. CENTER-RIGHT upper wall has a LARGE paper wall calendar with a racing car picture above a blank grid of small squares. RIGHT zone has a single bed with muted blue bedspread, and a prominent open motoring magazine resting on the foot of the bed, with small car photos and abstract columns, NO legible lettering. FAR RIGHT wall next to a doorway has a wooden key rack with three clearly visible bunches of car keys and colored key fobs. Through doorway a subtle small glimpse of a garage and a parked 1990s hatchback. Keep key rack clearly separated from bed and calendar.
Period details: wooden furniture, tiled or parquet floor, a couple of rally/touring car posters, shelf with modest trophies and model cars, stacked CD jewel cases, small old stereo, window at far left with a quiet Italian town and distant foothills. No people.
Mood: lived-in, humble, welcoming, peaceful late afternoon daylight. Warm wood, cream walls, teal, navy, muted red accents. Not luxury, not neon gaming room.
Constraints: scene only, NO interface, buttons, floating labels, borders, speech bubbles, watermarks or readable text. No laptops, flatscreens, smartphones, modern game consoles, modern cars or RGB lights. Make all six functional objects recognizable at reduced size.
